objects.aggregation: Separate each dataset throughout. Join its 128 matched timing records to frozen geometry/selection using archive_record_index and node_set_sha256; k=len(S), Ds=saved selected out-degree sum and Q=k*(k-1)/2. Take the median of the three original Numba32 edge_seconds values per case/method, then sum case medians. Rank Ds/Q against median(scan)/median(pairwise) with average ranks for exact ties; no threshold fitting or pooled correlation. The fixed alpha=1 proxy selects pairwise iff Q<=max(1,Ds), otherwise scan. Count strict scan/pair winners, exact ties and proxy agreement. Hindsight uses each case minimum, while proxy uses the already measured median of its selected method; baseline/policy factors divide sums, not per-case ratio averages. Friendster better constant is always pairwise; Citation2 better constant is always scan.
objects.claim_limits: Descriptive posthoc reuse of 256 existing matched case records, 128 per graph; Friendster reuses 90 physical pairs and Citation2 80 (128/126 distinct ordered sets). No independent-query claim, cross-graph timing pool, threshold search, confidence interval, cold-I/O experiment, routing/feature-computation overhead measurement, quality, complete-SEAL or end-to-end performance claim. Factors compare hypothetical sums of saved edge-construction medians; they are not measurements of a newly executed dispatcher.
